_about: G1 (venue-liquidity gate) replay fixtures: the exact JSON-RPC requests rpc.venue_facts made at each token's alert block on rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com (recorded 2026-10-01) and the node's answers. `head` = the block at the ledger's alert_ts (binary search on block timestamps). Trimmed: each log keeps address/blockNumber/logIndex/topics/data, and a SWAP log's data is emptied (the gate counts swaps and never reads their amounts). verify.py replays these through a fake rpc._call keyed on (method, params); a request the fixture does not hold fails the check.
